label: food_and_drink
name: Food and Drink Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR food or drink image into one or more detailed categories based on the visible dish, ingredient, preparation type, and beverage content.

labels.meal: A photo primarily showing a complete prepared meal or plated dish.
labels.fruit: A photo primarily showing one or more fruits, such as apples, bananas, oranges, berries, or tropical fruits.
labels.vegetables: A photo primarily showing one or more vegetables, either raw, cooked, or prepared.
labels.dessert: A photo primarily showing a sweet food such as cake, ice cream, pastry, pudding, or chocolate.
labels.beverage: A photo primarily showing a drink such as water, tea, coffee, juice, soda, milk, or a smoothie.
labels.snack: A photo primarily showing a small ready-to-eat food such as chips, nuts, biscuits, popcorn, or crackers.
labels.baked_goods: A photo primarily showing bread, cakes, cookies, pastries, muffins, or other baked food.
labels.seafood: A photo primarily showing fish, prawns, crabs, shellfish, or a prepared seafood dish.
labels.fast_food: A photo primarily showing fast food such as burgers, pizza, fries, sandwiches, or fried food.
